public_rationale: The records do not establish the predicted sequence for both companies. Anthropic's filing describes a proposed offering. S&P retained the eligibility rules for its flagship index family, but that does not prevent inclusion through other indices. No decisive event meets the early-resolution rule. With no deadline, the forecast remains open.
limitations: An offering filing is not an offering completion or index inclusion.
Rules for one index family cannot establish rules for every index.
Investment losses must be measured from the relevant holders' acquisition prices.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: As with SpaceX, Anthropic and OpenAI will be pushed into indices and index trackers and retail investors will suffer losses when reality catches up.

statement.excerpt: Same will happen with Anthropic and OpenAI.
statement.document_title: Why things will eventually fall apart

from_speaker: Index trackers will eat the loss
our_interpretation: Same refers to the immediately preceding prediction: public offerings followed by index inclusion and losses borne by index trackers and retail holders.
The prediction covers both Anthropic and OpenAI.
The reference to relaxed rules concerns accelerated or loosened index eligibility generally; no particular index is named.
When reality catches up describes the predicted correction, rather than an independently measurable antecedent that must occur before scoring.
The following separate prediction about 2026 is not imported as a deadline for this sentence.
criteria.support_condition: Both companies go public, enter major indices through the described accelerated or relaxed route, and subsequent losses are documented for tracking funds and retail holders at their actual acquisition prices.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A decisive terminal event makes the predicted sequence impossible for at least one named company, or the completed investment episode establishes that the specified holders did not incur the predicted losses. Temporary gains or delayed listings do not suffice.

evidence.publisher: Anthropic, PBC / U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
evidence.explanation: The filing documents preparation for an offering, rather than an already completed public-market and index-loss sequence. It neither confirms nor rules out the forecast.

evidence.locator: S&P 500, S&P MidCap 400, and S&P SmallCap 600 Results
evidence.explanation: This index family retained its eligibility rules, limiting a blanket relaxed-entry reading. Other index families can have different rules, so this does not contradict the overall forecast.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Official offering and index-entry records for both companies, followed by documented losses attributable to those holdings for index trackers and retail investors, or a terminal event making the predicted sequence impossible.
